text:
Lena: Heads-up — Altair just flagged a lead-time slip for our EU H100 allocation. 24 units pushed by ~7 days. They propose a split: 12 via air (expedite) and 12 via sea. Also they want to consolidate RMA DOAs into the same forwarder to save handling. Need routing + cost decision by EOD.

Raj: How bad is the immediate capacity hit? Can we keep p99 latency SLOs for prod clusters if we lose 6–8 GPUs this week? :thinking:

Maya: Altair, what are the exact ETA deltas for air vs sea and the incremental cost for air? We need numbers to justify approve.

Marco (Altair): Sorry for the hit — confirmed: air ETA to FRA 2–3 business days, sea ETA 14–18 days. Incremental air freight +€24,500 (inc. expedited docs/handling) for 12 units. Consolidated RMA AWB for the 3 DOAs can be appended to the air AWB if you choose air leg. We can cover DOA return shipping if DOA within 7 days after handoff.

Lena: Cargo note — if we split, customs windows differ (FRA vs AMS). That may add depot transfer / crossdock fees ~€800. Also a temporary HM tag needed for some power cables — adds ~€150.

shipping-bot: AWB draft created: `AWB: GT999-ALT-3456`. ETA (air to FRA) tentatively 2024-08-09. Insurance quote attached in thread. :package:

Raj: If we accept split, we should also flip low-priority batch jobs in eu-west to eu-central spare pool for 72h. I can apply routing. Also suggest enabling prefix caching to reduce token cost while we normalize.

Maya: Procurement: carrier payment + customs + consolidation => total uplift ~€26k–€27.5k. Finance sign-off required for anything >€20k. Jonah?

Jonah (Finance): Can approve up to €30k for critical expedite if infra confirms this prevents SLA breaches. Need written justification (short) and PO change request.

Raj: Quick mitigation plan: re-route non-prod to us-east temporarily, throttle background retrains. I can run reserves: `redwood-cli capacity reserve --region eu --count 24 --ttl 72h` if we decide to accept air. That pins capacity until shipment arrives.

Lena: One more RMA wrinkle — depot asked whether returns should be consolidated under single AWB or separate. Consolidated reduces handling but increases customs inspection risk. Marco, which do you prefer operationally?

Marco (Altair): Consolidated AWB preferred from our ops side (single manifest). We take on the risk of customs via our broker; it saves time and cost. We can also issue a depot pickup for the DOA units from your FRA hub once air arrives.

Maya: Shipping + consolidation + depot = estimate €27,150. Jonah allocated €30k contingency. We need procurement PO update + Marco to send final invoice and trade terms.

Jonah (Finance): Approved contingent on: (1) vendor cover DOA return cost if DOAs confirmed within SLA window, (2) PO updated with single-line expedite cost and contingency release. Send me a short sentence and I'll sign. :white_check_mark:

Lena: Decision — proceed with split shipment. Air for 12 units to FRA (expedite) and sea for remaining 12. Vendor to consolidate DOA RMA under air AWB and cover return freight per SLA. Procurement to update PO for up to €30k. Raj to apply temporary routing/priority changes.

Marco (Altair): Confirmed. I'll send revised proforma with `AWB: GT999-ALT-3456` and RMA manifest today. Will mark DOA return billing per SLA.

shipping-bot: AWB finalised: `AWB: GT999-ALT-3456` (air leg booked), carrier ETA 2024-08-09 10:00 CET to FRA hub.

Raj: I'll run the reserve and route changes now. Pinging infra-oncall to monitor p99 for next 48h.

Maya: I'll update the PO and ping Jonah for signature.

Lena: Thanks all. Follow-ups: Marco send invoice + RMA manifest; Raj confirm reserve applied; Jonah will sign PO. We'll reconvene if customs holds show up. :truck:
